_comment: Literary Marginalia corpus - 114 quotes, Bruce's own compilation. Recovered 2026-08-06 from the sassafras-proxy Worker's /marginalia endpoint (they had never been in this repo; commit 6f2cb95 added only the client JS). Shape: {quote, author, work?} - `work` is optional and renders italicised after the author.
